access_statement: Physical access: the raw genome-wide file ReplogleWeissman2022_K562_gwps.h5ad was present on the orchestration machine (Andres's Mac) by 10 October 2026, before this manifest was written, and the Adamson and Norman development arms read a knowledge file built from it (replogle2022_k562.json, first built into the Adamson bundle data/adamson_cf on 10 October, then into the Norman bundle: the responses of each development bundle's own targets, which this manifest excludes; docs/LAB_STATE.md, docs/results/external_replogle2022_k562_v2.md, docs/results/external_replogle2022_k562_norman.md). This tool opened only the obs and var tables; no expression value of any candidate target was read for any choice here. The holder obtains the file from the public record, never from the Mac, and scores the deposited predictions once (docs/PLAN_R_FRESH_TEST.md).

common_gene_panel.definition: frozen universe genes the cohort measures through exactly one var column, in universe order; cohort_symbols[i] is the cohort's var symbol for genes[i]; ambiguous lists universe genes with several cohort columns, left out

rules.in_distribution: member of a Reactome or CORUM class holding a training-panel target
